mechanism: Nicotine increases sympathomimetic effects and may accelerate amitriptyline metabolism via CYP1A2 induction, while amitriptyline potentiates nicotine's cardiovascular effects through anticholinergic and noradrenergic mechanisms.
action: Monitor heart rate, blood pressure, and cardiac arrhythmias; counsel patient on smoking cessation as nicotine may reduce amitriptyline efficacy and increase cardiovascular risk; consider dose adjustment if patient quits smoking.
